description: The pie chart represents the distribution of various relational association capabilities evaluated in a benchmark for multi-granularity and multi-image visual language models. There are a total of 10 categories shown, each with a distinct color and percentage. The categories and their respective percentages are as follows: ObservationAngle (12.28%), SimilarMaterial (10.33%), SubEvent (9.74%), UsageSimilarity (9.65%), Environment (8.77%), Layout (8.77%), AppearanceSimilarity (8.77%), SimilarEvent (8.77%), MentalitySimilarity (8.67%), and NearSameEntity (6.34%). The chart includes percentage labels inside the slices and does not have a legend. The slices are not visually emphasized in any particular way.
